description: This file defines the 'dBug' class, a PHP debugging tool that dumps and displays variable contents with colored and tabular formatting. It provides methods for introspecting arrays, objects, resources, XML data, and more, including JavaScript for toggleable views.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A PHP class that provides debugging output with collapsible and styled variable dumps, supporting arrays, objects, resources, XML, and other types.

methods.name: dBug
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the debugger, including optional forced type display.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the variable name that instantiated this debugger instance by inspecting the backtrace.

methods.name: makeTableHeader
methods.description: Creates the main table header for a dump section.

methods.name: makeTDHeader
methods.description: Creates a header row for a variable's key.

methods.name: closeTDRow
methods.description: Closes a table data row.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns an error message if a variable's type cannot be handled.

methods.name: checkType
methods.description: Checks and dispatches the variable type to appropriate handler functions.

methods.name: varIsNULL
methods.description: Handles null variables.

methods.name: varIsBoolean
methods.description: Handles boolean variables, displaying TRUE or FALSE.

methods.name: varIsArray
methods.description: Handles array variables, recursively dumping their contents.

methods.name: varIsObject
methods.description: Handles object variables, dumps properties and methods.

methods.name: varIsResource
methods.description: Handles resource variables, dispatches based on resource type.

methods.name: varIsDBResource
methods.description: Handles database resource types, displaying fields and rows.

methods.name: varIsGDResource
methods.description: Handles GD image resource, dumping dimensions and color count.

methods.name: varIsXml
methods.description: Handles XML data, either from a string or resource.

methods.name: varIsXmlResource
methods.description: Parses and displays an XML resource or string using an XML parser, with event handlers.

methods.name: xmlParse
methods.description: Encapsulates XML parsing and error handling.

methods.name: xmlStartElement
methods.description: Handler for XML start tags, initializes element dumps.

methods.name: xmlEndElement
methods.description: Handler for XML end tags, displays element content and children.

methods.name: xmlCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements.

methods.name: xmlDefaultHandler
methods.description: Handles miscellaneous XML data such as comments.

methods.name: initJSandCSS
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript and CSS for toggling and styling dump output.
